query:
select exists (
               select 1 from plugin_runs r join connections c on c.id = r.connection_id
               where r.id = $1 and c.user_id = $2 and c.source = $3 and r.status = 'running'
                 and r.heartbeat_at >= now() - make_interval(secs => $4)
           ) as "live!"
